question.trigger_rationale: The current-configuration consumer and retained context-keyed support give a concrete distinction between an old-only majority and both joint majorities. feedback.answered: The read consumer uses the current voter sets against a context-keyed acknowledgment map that contains no configuration snapshot. switchToConfig retains that map. A single-request scope avoids read queue batching as an alternative release mechanism.
